title: pteridium latiusculum subsp. japonicum
intro: Pteridium latiusculum subsp. japonicum, commonly known as Japanese bracken fern, is a type of fern species native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Japanese bracken fern are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which can modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-cancer properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential interactions of Japanese bracken fern.
